SWC-101.title: Integer Overflow and Underflow
SWC-101.summary: Arithmetic that wraps because it is performed in an unchecked block, in Solidity below 0.8, or through an unsafe cast to a narrower type.

SWC-104.title: Unchecked Call Return Value
SWC-104.summary: The boolean or returndata of a low level call, send or non-standard ERC20 transfer is discarded, so a silent failure is treated as success.

SWC-105.title: Unprotected Ether Withdrawal
SWC-105.summary: A state changing or value moving function is callable by any account because the authorisation check is missing or applied to the wrong role.

SWC-107.title: Reentrancy
SWC-107.summary: An external call is made before the contract finishes updating its own state, letting the callee re-enter and observe or exploit the intermediate state.

SWC-112.title: Delegatecall to Untrusted Callee
SWC-112.summary: delegatecall executes foreign code against local storage, so an untrusted or attacker chosen target can rewrite any slot including the admin and implementation slots.

SWC-113.title: DoS with Failed Call
SWC-113.summary: A push payment to an untrusted recipient is required to succeed, so a recipient that reverts can block a state transition for everyone.

SWC-114.title: Transaction Order Dependence
SWC-114.summary: The outcome depends on the ordering of transactions inside a block, which a searcher or builder can choose. Covers sandwich attacks and missing slippage bounds.

SWC-115.title: Authorization through tx.origin
SWC-115.summary: Authorisation compares tx.origin instead of msg.sender, so any contract the authorised account is induced to call can act on its behalf.

SWC-117.title: Signature Malleability
SWC-117.summary: ecrecover accepts a second valid encoding of the same signature with the s value in the upper half of the curve order, and returns address zero on malformed input.

SWC-120.title: Weak Sources of Randomness
SWC-120.summary: Randomness is derived from block fields such as timestamp, prevrandao or blockhash, all of which the block builder can observe or influence before inclusion.

SWC-121.title: Missing Protection against Signature Replay
SWC-121.summary: A signed message can be submitted more than once because the digest omits a nonce, a chain identifier or the verifying contract address.

SWC-128.title: DoS With Block Gas Limit
SWC-128.summary: An unbounded loop over an array that any account can grow makes a function exceed the block gas limit and revert permanently.

SWC-000.title: Protocol and Economic Logic
SWC-000.summary: Local catch-all used in this corpus for defects that are correct at the language level but violate a protocol invariant: oracle design, share accounting, rounding direction, incentive design and upgrade safety.
